# Jojogurt Games

> Jojogurt Games is a solo indie game studio from Poland. It makes small mobile puzzle and memory games for iPhone, built in Godot. Principles: no ads where kids play, no dark patterns anywhere. Contact: jojogurt.games@gmail.com

## Games

- [Cosmic Path](https://jojogurt.github.io/cosmic-path.html): Visual memory and brain-training game in deep space. Watch a comet trace a path across the grid, then draw it back from memory — portals, boss levels, a daily challenge and a Relax mode. Free on the App Store (https://apps.apple.com/app/id1355832531); an optional one-time purchase removes ads.
- [Mosaic Reveal](https://jojogurt.github.io/mosaic-reveal.html): Cozy visual-memory puzzle. Watch a sector of a space picture flash, then tap the tiles back from memory — 23 hand-made space mosaics, a daily mosaic with a streak, no ads, no subscriptions. Coming soon to iOS.
- [Memo Mini](https://jojogurt.github.io/memo-mini.html): Relaxing memory pairs (matching) game for kids 4+. 14 colorful worlds, 175 pictures, learn words in 7 languages — no ads, no timers. Free on the App Store (https://apps.apple.com/app/id6766694453) with optional one-time purchases.
- [First to Floor](https://jojogurt.github.io/first-to-floor.html): Guess-the-order physics game for kids 4+. Watch a slow-motion preview and predict which items hit the floor first. No ads. Free on the App Store (https://apps.apple.com/app/id6765926150).
- [Memo Maze](https://jojogurt.github.io/memo-maze.html): Memory maze puzzle. Study a tile maze, watch it vanish, then swipe through it from memory across 30 hand-crafted levels. In development.

## Apps

- [MedBinder](https://jojogurt.github.io/apps/medbinder/): Private medical records app for the whole family on iPhone and iPad. Keeps lab results, prescriptions, documents, doctor visit recordings, medications and vaccinations on the device - no account, no cloud, no tracking, on-device AI. 19 languages. Not a medical device. Coming soon to the App Store.
- [NextLeg](https://jojogurt.github.io/apps/nextleg/): Group activity app for iPhone. Everyone has a personal daily goal (steps, running km, cycling km or active calories from Apple Health); together the group closes a shared goal, keeps a streak, takes on weekly challenges, duels other groups and climbs city/country/world rankings. Reads Apple Health only and sends daily totals, never raw samples; manual entries ignored. English and Polish. Not a medical device. Coming soon to the App Store.

## Browser games

- [Uszy & Mózg](https://jojogurt.github.io/stacja/): Music pub-quiz trainer (Polish only). Guess the song, artist and year — solo, as a daily challenge or live with friends. Plays in the browser, no install.
